## Invoice Report INTROSPECT (read-only)
Proves what `account.invoice.report` actually exposes on THIS Odoo before any
sync is written. Writes nothing anywhere.

**Sample Refunds** returns 5 posted CREDIT NOTES with every readable field
(no fieldsList = Odoo returns them all). Two things to read off it:
1. the full field list -> confirms move_id / invoice_user_id /
   commercial_partner_id / payment_state exist
2. whether `quantity` and `price_subtotal` are NEGATIVE

If refunds are NOT negative, the sync must negate them explicitly or every
return will ADD to revenue instead of subtracting.

**Sample Invoices** is the same for 5 normal invoices, to compare signs.

Uses the existing `live-version` Odoo credential. Nothing to configure -
just Run once, then send the Report node's output back.
